_documentation.PURPOSE: Per-network playbook: what each network is for, how to cut and caption for it, tags, times, profile and comment handling. Shown in the UI next to each network.
_documentation.SOURCE: docs/research/2026-11-09-channel-playbooks.md (every value is cited there; [unverified] marks values no official page confirmed).
_documentation.RULES: Owner's rule wins: at most one post per network per day, 19:00 JST by default. times.bestJst are alternatives to test against 19:00, never extra posts; cadencePerWeek is a ceiling.
_documentation.FIELDS: format.idealSec is [min, max]. null means not documented. linkInCaption = a link in the post text is clickable and not discouraged.
